schedules.name: mealplan-wednesday
schedules.content: Meal-planning week starts (first text). Follow skill custos-mealplan: `mealplan brief`, propose dinners for the coming Saturday pickup within the family's constraints, one message to the Collette Haus group (or one each to Hal and Dani) — candidates as `Title — <link>` lines, then the questions from `mealplan prefs` — then `mealplan plan proposed`. Track it on one goal for the week (reuse it if it exists).

schedules.name: mealplan-thursday
schedules.content: Check-in day. Follow skill custos-mealplan: `mealplan plan show`. Skipped week → nothing. No first message yet → propose now exactly as on Wednesday (candidates with links, the questions, then `mealplan plan proposed`). Proposed but nobody engaged → one short reminder in the Collette Haus group with the draft as day-by-day links. Engaged → nothing unless one decision is still open.

schedules.name: mealplan-friday
schedules.content: Cart setup. Follow skill custos-mealplan: skipped week or no reply all week → one line to the group at most, no cart. Otherwise finalize the plan, build the list, fill the cart, then message the Collette Haus group the plan day by day (`Weekday: Title — <link>`), groceries, subtotal, and that Hal places the order and picks the Saturday window in the Amazon app. Money rules apply: never check out.
